nodes.name: White tie
nodes.picture: tailcoats, white waistcoats, floor-length gowns and gloves under chandeliers, every figure precise and upright

nodes.name: Black tie
nodes.picture: dinner jackets and evening gowns at a gala, polished floors, champagne, posed elegance

nodes.name: Cocktail
nodes.picture: short evening dresses and sharp suits, small groups mingling with glasses, warm party lighting

feature_notes.why: Debrett's: cocktail is a semi-formal code with a 'lesser emphasis on formality' than black tie / lounge suit; Post lists it as the dressy-but-flexible tier

nodes.name: Business formal
nodes.picture: dark suits and ties, conference tables, lanyards, tidy posture, neutral rooms

nodes.name: Business casual
nodes.picture: open collars, blazers without ties, open-plan offices, coffee mugs, relaxed competence

nodes.name: Smart-casual
nodes.picture: neat but easy clothes, cafes and weekends, tidy sneakers, soft daylight, nothing stiff

nodes.name: Streetwear
nodes.picture: oversized hoodies, graphic tees, fresh sneakers, crews on pavements, bold logos and layering

nodes.name: Athleisure
nodes.picture: leggings, track jackets, sports shoes, gyms and park paths, bodies in easy motion

nodes.name: Loungewear
nodes.picture: pyjamas, oversized knits and socks, slumped on couches, blankets, morning-after softness

nodes.name: Festival wear
nodes.picture: glitter, flower crowns, painted faces, mismatched colour, crowds in fields at dusk

nodes.name: Coronation
nodes.picture: crowns on cushions, ermine, an enthroned figure crowned by robed clergy, a hushed nave of witnesses

nodes.name: State funeral
nodes.picture: flag-draped coffin on a gun carriage, black-clad mourners in perfect ranks, bowed heads

nodes.name: Wedding
nodes.picture: white dress, flowers, an aisle, a gathered congregation, rice and tears, held hands

nodes.name: Graduation
nodes.picture: gowns and mortarboards, a stage, rows of folding chairs, diplomas, thrown caps

nodes.name: Tea ceremony
nodes.picture: a bare tatami room, a kneeling host, bowls and a whisk, deliberate gestures, one flower

nodes.name: High mass
nodes.picture: candles, incense smoke in light shafts, vestments, an altar, a singers' loft, a kneeling congregation

nodes.name: Temple procession
nodes.picture: a palanquin and banners carried through streets, drums, marigolds and incense, devout crowds

nodes.name: Military parade
nodes.picture: ranked columns in step, rifles at the same angle, banners and a reviewing stand, absolute symmetry

nodes.name: Changing of the guard
nodes.picture: sentries in tall hats exchanging posts in exact choreography before a palace gate, watched by tourists

nodes.name: Royal court
nodes.picture: audience hall, courtiers bowing in order of rank, a dais, tapestries, whispered protocol

nodes.name: Diplomatic summit
nodes.picture: a long table with flags and nameplates, translators, handshakes for the cameras, careful distance

nodes.name: Boardroom
nodes.picture: a glass-walled room, a long polished table, slides, a head of table, folded hands

nodes.name: Faculty senate
nodes.picture: robed academics around a horseshoe table, stacks of paper, wood panelling, solemn debate

nodes.name: Family Sunday dinner
nodes.picture: a crowded table of dishes, grandparents at the head, passed plates, the good tablecloth

nodes.name: Sleepover
nodes.picture: a floor of sleeping bags, pillow forts, fairy lights, snacks, whispering friends in pyjamas

nodes.name: Dive bar
nodes.picture: a low-lit counter, neon beer signs, a jukebox, mismatched stools, regulars slumped over drinks

nodes.name: Rave
nodes.picture: a dark warehouse of strobes and lasers, a swarm of dancing bodies, smoke, light trails

nodes.name: Campfire
nodes.picture: a circle on logs around a fire, faces lit orange, sparks, a guitar, stories

nodes.name: Perfect symmetry
nodes.picture: a mirror-image composition on a central axis, matched columns, identical figures either side

nodes.name: Grid order
nodes.picture: figures and objects in modular rows, repeated units, aligned shelves and desks, orthogonal calm

nodes.name: Procession axis
nodes.picture: a long central aisle drawing the eye to a distant focal point, flanked by ranks of onlookers

nodes.name: Organic sprawl
nodes.picture: winding paths, uneven buildings, things growing every direction, no axis, lived-in spread

nodes.name: Cluttered nest
nodes.picture: piles, nooks, blankets and shelves overflowing, a lived-in den with a warm centre

nodes.name: Wilderness
nodes.picture: untouched ridges, tangled forest, weather, no human arrangement at all

nodes.name: Regency ballroom
nodes.picture: empire-waist gowns and tailcoats in lines for a country dance, candles, mirrors, chaperones watching

nodes.name: Victorian parlour
nodes.picture: dark wood, heavy drapes, doilies, stiff upholstery, portraits, a ticking clock, buttoned collars

nodes.name: Art Deco gala
nodes.picture: gold geometry, sunburst motifs, long gloves and sleek tuxedos, a grand staircase, jazz-age sparkle

nodes.name: Mid-century office
nodes.picture: rows of identical desks, typewriters, ties and pencil skirts, filing cabinets, venetian blinds

nodes.name: Brutalist civic
nodes.picture: raw concrete halls, enormous empty plazas, tiny officials, hard shadows, monumental repetition

nodes.name: Bauhaus
nodes.picture: primary-colour geometry, tubular steel, clean sans type, asymmetrical balance, honest materials

nodes.name: Punk
nodes.picture: safety pins, torn denim, spiked hair, flyers on walls, a cramped gig, raised fists

nodes.name: Grunge
nodes.picture: flannel and thrifted layers, dim basements, tangled hair, tape-spooled posters, slouching

nodes.name: Y2K
nodes.picture: glossy plastics, butterfly clips, metallic fabrics, chunky early gadgets, bubbly futurism

nodes.name: Liturgical
nodes.picture: a congregation mid-response, open books, lifted hands, candlelight, a cadence of repetition

nodes.name: Legalese
nodes.picture: clerks and judges, stamped documents, a raised bench, wigs or robes, the weight of procedure

feature_notes.why: Joos places formulaic legal and ceremonial texts at the frozen end; legal speech is boilerplate recited in a fixed form

nodes.name: Newsreader
nodes.picture: a desk and camera, a straight-backed presenter, a neutral backdrop, even lighting, steady eye contact

nodes.name: Chatty
nodes.picture: people talking over each other at a table, hands moving, laughing, leaning in

nodes.name: Slang
nodes.picture: friends hanging off a wall, phones out, shoulder bumps, in-jokes, loose posture

nodes.name: Silence
nodes.picture: a still room, no one speaking, a long held look, empty space around each figure

nodes.name: Everyday
nodes.picture: relaxed but composed, ordinary life done well, neat rooms and plain clothes

nodes.name: Feral
nodes.picture: untamed, chaotic, wild-haired, nothing arranged, mud and weather and motion

nodes.name: Slacker
nodes.picture: rumpled, lounging, unmade beds and couches, crumbs, an afternoon going nowhere

nodes.name: Street
nodes.picture: candid, graffiti, sneakers, caught in passing, crowds, quick glances and city edges

nodes.name: Domestic
nodes.picture: homey, kitchen tables, cardigans and aprons, the mess of real life, hands busy

nodes.name: Festive
nodes.picture: parties, festivals, crowds, colour and play, banners, streamers, raised cups

nodes.name: Professional
nodes.picture: offices, uniforms of work, tidy desks, name tags, purposeful posture

nodes.name: Academic
nodes.picture: libraries, gowns, lecterns, quiet order, long shelves, bent heads

nodes.name: Diplomatic
nodes.picture: state dinners, flags, protocol, careful distance, interpreters at shoulders

nodes.name: Martial
nodes.picture: parade grounds, ranks, drill, strict symmetry, saluting hands

nodes.name: Ritual
nodes.picture: vestments, altars, processions, sacred ceremony, ordered gestures

nodes.name: Courtly
nodes.picture: thrones, regalia, absolute symmetry and hierarchy, silks and gold

nodes.name: Flirty
nodes.picture: playful glances over a shoulder, a light touch on the arm, dressed up just a little, warm low light, two people standing closer than they need to
nodes.voice: teasing, light and playful, quick banter and knowing smiles

nodes.name: Scandalous
nodes.picture: a breach of decorum at a formal occasion: a daring outfit in a room of gowns, gasps behind fans, a spilled glass, whispering guests turning to stare, a defiant smile
nodes.voice: gossipy and delicious, arch asides, rumours passed behind gloved hands

sources.cite: Martin Joos, The Five Clocks (1962): frozen / formal / consultative / casual / intimate styles
sources.used_for: Speech-register links (liturgical/legalese = frozen, boardroom/professional = consultative, chatty/sleepover = casual/intimate); legalese ritual fix

sources.cite: Debrett's, Deconstructing Dress Codes / Events and Dress Codes (white tie = royal ceremonies and balls; black tie; lounge suit = business; cocktail = US semi-formal)
sources.used_for: Dress code ladder and which occasions each code belongs to; cocktail rigidity fix

sources.cite: Emily Post Institute, Black Tie Dress Code guide and Wedding Guest Attire (black tie common for weddings; cocktail and business casual definitions)
sources.used_for: Dress code to wedding / reception / office links

sources.cite: Erving Goffman, The Presentation of Self in Everyday Life (1959): front, back and off-stage regions
sources.used_for: Front-stage to back-stage arcs (boardroom -> family dinner, state funeral -> wake, cocktail receptions)

sources.cite: Victor Turner, The Ritual Process: Structure and Anti-Structure (1969); liminality, communitas; Bakhtin carnival inversion
sources.used_for: Ritual -> festive/party inversion arcs (wedding -> reception -> dive bar, rave -> sleepover) and anti-structure contrasts (punk at the ballroom)

sources.cite: Brown & Levinson, Politeness: Some Universals in Language Usage (1987): social distance, power, imposition
sources.used_for: Power-distance links (court, boardroom, summit, silence as face-saving)

sources.cite: Biber & Conrad, Register, Genre, and Style (2009/2019): registers = situation of use + linguistic features
sources.used_for: Principle: link a speech register to the situation that hosts it (settings bring their register)

sources.cite: TV Tropes / No Film School: Fish Out of Water and formal-event juxtaposition conventions; general narrative convention (period settings, era aesthetics)
sources.used_for: Deliberate contrasts (punk at the ball, couture at the gala) and setting/era co-occurrence; many 0.3-0.6 links are editorial judgement, not directly sourced

story.notes: Links are mostly undirected co-occurrence; dir 'a->b' marks one-way story flow (transition/arc_pair). Suggested use: when walking the probe, follow synapses by w and, for arcs, in dir. Graph is symmetric by kind: treat 'contrast' links as high-interest jumps (story juxtaposition) rather than similarity. Joos mapping: frozen = liturgical/high-mass/coronation text; formal = royal-court, diplomatic, boardroom; consultative = professional/business; casual = chatty/slang/dive-bar; intimate = sleepover/domestic/loungewear. Stick registers (courtly, ritual, martial, diplomatic...) duplicate seed nodes; they are linked like their twins but consider merging. Degree cap of 8 was enforced by dropping the lowest-w links; only ~208 links survive (< target 200-280 upper range) because of the cap with 66 nodes. Many whys for low-weight links are editorial; only dress-code ladder, Joos styles, Goffman regions, Turner ritual/anti-structure and politeness power-distance have direct sources.
